Basehome network topology

Proxmox host, Kubuntu guest, Docker services, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel (Immich only), and wdred NFS. Edit topology.yaml, then re-run the renderer — do not hand-edit generated MD/HTML.

3 Services

Service URL Path Edge Status Notes
Jellyfin http://player.maktaba.home /srv/maktaba maktaba-caddy (:80) live Media on NFS maktaba/media
TubeArchivist http://yt.maktaba.home /srv/maktaba maktaba-caddy (:80) live YouTube archive; ES/Redis on VM disk
Vaultwarden https://vault.maktaba.home /srv/vaultwarden vaultwarden-caddy (:443, tls internal) live Tailscale-only; daily SQLite backups
dnsmasq *.maktaba.home /etc/dnsmasq.d/maktaba.conf — live Split-DNS nameserver for Tailscale
Immich https://photos.homz.fyi · https://photos.maktaba.home /srv/immich Cloudflare Tunnel (public) + vaultwarden-caddy (admin) live Public: photos.homz.fyi via tunnel maktaba-immich + Access (OTP / service token). Admin: photos.maktaba.home on Tailscale. Library on shared/immich/library (NFS); Postgres on VM disk. Cgroup memory limits (~6.25G). Vaultwarden not on this tunnel. See docs/immich/operations.md and docs/immich/public-access-runbook.md.
Homepage https://home.maktaba.home /srv/homepage vaultwarden-caddy (:443, tls internal) planned Start-page dashboard (gethomepage). Config on VM SSD; optional Docker socket RO. See docs/homepage/setup-plan.md.
Forgejo https://git.maktaba.home /srv/forgejo vaultwarden-caddy (:443, tls internal) planned Self-hosted Git forge. Postgres + repos on VM SSD; HTTPS git day one; no runner yet. See docs/forgejo/setup-plan.md.

Remote access

Tailscale mesh (no port-forward). Immich also public via Cloudflare Tunnel + Access at photos.homz.fyi — Vaultwarden stays Tailscale-only.

Not exposed to internet:

  • Jellyfin
  • TubeArchivist
  • Vaultwarden
  • Homepage
  • Forgejo

7 Invariants

  • No new public-facing service without a REGISTRY row
  • Do not expose app ports on the ISP router; Tailscale first (Immich public path is Tunnel + Access only)
  • Immich tunnel must never publish Vaultwarden or other services — photos.homz.fyi only
  • Only Proxmox mounts the USB block device; guests use NFS
  • NFS exports restricted to 192.168.11.141 (not whole LAN)
  • Postgres / ES / Redis stay on VM disk — never on NFS
  • No secrets in basehome-ops git
